event: Badan Geologi raises Anak Krakatau to Level III (Siaga); eruption resumes after pause since 16 Dec 2023
note: Strombolian series until 5 Sep; >240 eruptions reported by Kompas

event: Continuous eruption (erupsi menerus) begins with lava fountaining and rumbling
note: Start/end times officially confirmed; column height not observable from the ground; max amplitude 70 mm per Kompas

event: Ash column reported to 15 km asl (FL500) moving W ~74 km/h; second layer 5.5 km moving S
note: NOTE: Badan Geologi published NO column height (tinggi kolom erupsi tidak teramati). All heights are VAAC/aviation or observer estimates. Monitoring cameras were damaged by ejecta.

event: Lower plume ~6 km (20000 ft) drifts NE over Banten/Jakarta/West Java
Acoustic booms heard in Java and Sumatra
note: Three provinces reported booms (ANTARA)

event: Continuous eruption ends after 25 h; 3 Strombolian eruptions follow
note: Return to Strombolian provisionally read as end of the continuous phase; probability of further eruption still high

event: CGK and HLP suspend operations (first NOTAM to 09:30); TKG to 10:00
note: AFP: 209 flights and >22,000 pax affected at CGK in first closure

event: Total of 8 airports closed in Java and Sumatra
note: CGK, HLP, TKG Lampung, Husein Sastranegara Bandung, Budiarto Curug, Pondok Cabe, M. Taufiq Kiemas Pesisir Barat, Atung Bungsu (Pagar Alam, South Sumatra)

event: Ministry of Transport cumulative impact (superseded)
note: ~170,000 passengers. Affected = cancelled + delayed + postponed + diverted + return-to-base per DGCA release 4887, NOT cancellations alone

event: Singapore Airlines cancels Singapore-Jakarta flights; Scoot also
Lion Group cancellations (domestic+international)
Garuda cancels/reschedules all Jakarta-Bandung-Lampung flights through midday 7 Sep
Kemenhub designates 5 alternate airports (Kertajati; Juanda; Ahmad Yani; Adi Soemarmo; YIA); later 10 airports on 24-h ops
note: Free onward train/bus/Whoosh for diverted passengers; InJourney Airports coordinates

event: SIGMET: ash to 15000 ft moving W at 15 kt
Four airports (incl. CGK) extend closure to 18:00 WIB; one South Sumatra airport reopens 09:00
CGK flights affected on 7 Sep morning
note: ~30,000 passengers Monday morning (Al Jazeera)

event: Government cumulative impact (most authoritative)
source: Transport Minister Dudy Purwagandhi and Coordinating Minister Agus Harimurti Yudhoyono, independently, via ANTARA 2026-09-08
note: ~341,000 passengers. Same national series as the 1,558 figure at a later cut-off, not a conflicting estimate. NO FINAL TALLY PUBLISHED: last DGCA release is 4887 of 6 Sep

event: Jakarta orders remote learning (PJJ) for all school levels
INACA airline loss simulation (CGK and TKG only; 30-50 cancellations/day)
source: Bayu Sutanto, Secretary General INACA, via Sindonews
note: Rp19bn is the TOP of a range. Rp70-130bn is the same model weekly, not a separate estimate. Components: revenue 8-15bn, fuel/crew/parking 1.5-3bn, passenger compensation 0.5-1.2bn

event: Supply Chain Indonesia trade-flow exposure at CGK
unit: USD million per day gross trade flow
source: Setijadi, Supply Chain Indonesia, via Tempo/RRI
note: Exports US$9.90bn and IMPORTS US$20.77bn per year (Tempo English mislabels imports as exports). 8-h stoppage delays ~US$28m (exports 9.04 + imports 18.97). Exposure, not loss

event: INDEF CGE model: Q3 growth impact
source: Rizal Taufikurahman, Head of Macroeconomic and Finance Research, INDEF, via CNBC Indonesia
note: Assumes one week of disruption with half the activity recovering by end-September. Alternative: three weeks with 20% recovery gives -0.015pp. NOT a GDP level change

event: Badan Geologi keeps Level III; no potential for tsunamigenic collapse; public told not to believe tsunami rumours; 3-km exclusion
note: 6-7 Sep seismicity: 3 eruption, 9 emission, 93 low-frequency, 98 hybrid, 4 tremor, 1 shallow volcanic

event: BNPB confirms no fatalities and no physical damage; no official government damage estimate exists
note: Finance Minister Purbaya: no economic incentives planned, state budget unaffected

event: InJourney Service Recovery Activation: free buses on 4 routes; 60-bed rest area in Terminal 3
source: Arie Ahsanurrohim, Corporate Secretary Group Head, InJourney Airports
note: Whoosh high-speed rail ran NORMALLY and was not a relief service (KCIC). No count of passengers carried has been published

event: Soekarno-Hatta reopens; Halim/Bandung/Budiarto/Pondok Cabe also reopen overnight
note: NOT all airports: Radin Inten II, M. Taufiq Kiemas and Salakanagara stayed closed to ~10:00 WIB. Salakanagara was not in the original list of eight

event: DGCA issues circular SE-DJPU 15/2026 on handling volcanic ash impacts on flight operations (effective retroactively from 6 Sep)
source: DGCA press release 4888; Director General Lukman F. Laisa
note: Mandates operator Safety Risk Assessment, aircraft protection and OEM-guided cleaning, airport and AirNav monitoring, passenger handling (compensation/reroute/refund/reschedule), and mandatory reporting of volcanic ash encounters. Builds on KP 153/2019 CDM. Indonesia adopts the ICAO Doc 9974 SRA approach during the eruption

event: Badan Geologi evaluation: 13 Strombolian eruptions cumulative since the continuous eruption ended; seismicity declining, RSAM low energy, tiltmeters flat; Level III (Siaga) and 3 km exclusion radius maintained
note: Return to Strombolian activity still interpreted provisionally as the end of the long continuous eruption episode. Eruption probability in coming periods remains HIGH. Hazards: incandescent ejecta with heavy ashfall; lava flows if continuous eruption resumes. Plume column height AGAIN not observed (tinggi kolom erupsi tidak teramati) - third consecutive evaluation with no quantitative height, six days after eruption onset. Seismicity 9-10 Sep: 1 eruption, 6 exhalation, 3 low frequency, 5 hybrid, continuous tremor, 1 shallow volcanic, 3 distant tectonic

event: Badan Geologi evaluation splits the trend: shallow-associated seismicity declining but Vulkanik Dangkal (28) and Vulkanik Dalam (18) increasing, explicitly read as magma supply from depth
note: Reverses the simple winding-down reading of 10 Sep. Seismicity 10-11 Sep: 1 eruption, 21 Low Frequency, 13 Hybrid, continuous tremor, 28 Vulkanik Dangkal, 18 Vulkanik Dalam - large rises from 9-10 Sep (1 shallow volcanic, 3 LF, 5 hybrid). RSAM rose 5 Sep then declining since 6 Sep; tiltmeters still flat. Level III (Siaga) and 3 km radius maintained; eruption probability still HIGH. Plume column height again not observed - fourth consecutive evaluation. NOTE: the document labels Low Frequency and Hybrid as shallow-associated and Vulkanik Dangkal plus Vulkanik Dalam as deep-associated, which is internally inconsistent since Dangkal means shallow; cite the phase names verbatim alongside the agency interpretation
